comments.text:
Thank you so much for this beautiful travel documentary and for visiting my little country 🇸🇹 
We just didn't like the mix of images you used; some images in this video don't correspond to the reality of São Tomé (false). I hope you enjoyed going there.

comments.text: The story of the sea turtles on Praia Jalé and how the local conservation program saved them was so heart-warming. Beautiful culture and people.
